title: Haqa Daldaltoota Gidduutti
intro: Lakkoofsi tokko ummata sossobbiin bu’aatiin nyaatame fuuldura dhaabatee, walitti dhufeenya isaanii keessatti amanamummaa fi haqummaatti isaan waama ture. Gabrichi Rabbii kun safartuu gabaabaa kennuu fi miizaana akka hin jijjiiramne akeekkachiise. Ummanni nama dhuunfaa kana lafa isaa irraa ari’a jedhee doorsisuun dhaggeeffachuu dide. Lafti mataan ishee firdiin isaan irratti ka'a turte. Lakkoofsi daldaltoota biratti haqaaf dhaabbate kun eenyu?
clues: Ummata daldalaa fi daldala keessatti gadi fageenyaan liqimfameef ergamaa ta’ee ergame.
Sabni koo yeroo meeshaa namaaf madaalu safartuu gabaabaa kenna ture.
Yoon gara amantiitti isaan waamu irratti cichee biyya irraa na ari'u jedhanii doorsisan.
Raajoota keessaa nama dubbii gaarii dubbatu ta'uun yaadatama.
Sabni koo kirkira lafaa hamaa lubbuu dhabee qe'ee isaa keessatti hafe.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Ummata kootiin ibidda boba'aa keessa darbadhaa
Falfaltoota Fara'oon jabaa tokkoo wajjin wal dura dhaabbate
Fedhii gaala dubaraa dhagaa irraa oomishuuf qaban mudate
Magaalaan koo waraana ergamootaatiin akka diigamtu argeera

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Sabni koo kirkira lafaa hamaadhaan qabame
Ummanni koo qilleensi iyyaa tureen faffaca'e
Garaa qurxummii guddaa tokko keessa osoon jiruu fayye
outcome.answer: Sabni koo kirkira lafaa hamaadhaan qabame

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
